intro: The Great Tree Provides is a quest in Dolanaar where Byancie enlists aid to halt a dangerous affliction threatening Eralya. By harvesting dewy lasher fronds from Teldrassil's lakes and gathering basic supplies, players help prepare an urgent restorative salve.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I will need your help acquiring the ingredients I need to stop the affliction long enough for Eralya to make it back here for further treatment.
Thankfully, our living home is still bountiful and will provide in our time of need.
The core ingredient is dewy lasher fronds. You'll find them around Lake Al'Ameth directly south of here, or Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest.
In addition, I'll need an empty vial and some spring water. Both can be bought here in town, or traded for.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the ingredients? I fear Eralya may not have long.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for your help. Please, accept this to help with the costs of the vial and water.
Now, to make the salve. It should only take a moment.
